name: Radon变换分析
description: 使用 the Radon transform 以检测 directional 伪影 and periodic 模式 表明 图像篡改.
algorithm: Radon Domain Feature Extraction for Forgery Detection
mechanism: Projects image content along multiple angles using the Radon transform, creating a sinogram representation. Manipulated regions produce anomalous directional 模式 in the Radon domain.
parameters: Angles: 0-179° (1° step), Projection: line integral, Domain: spatial→Radon, Feature: sinogram 方差
source: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2008) — Blind Authentication Using Periodic Properties of Interpolation, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting geometric 篡改 and resampling through directional 伪影 分析

references.title: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2008) — Blind Authentication Using Periodic Properties of Interpolation, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• 检测 directional 篡改 伪影
• Robust to noise
• Complements 频域 methods
• Can reveal hidden periodicity
limitations:
• 计算成本高 for large images
• Limited to directional 伪影
• Requires careful parameter tuning
• May miss non-directional forgeries
